It is the source of all things and cannot be fully expressed in words.","Pronunciation (English)":"dào","Part of Speech (English)":"noun","Register (English)":"philosophical, literary, classical","Nuance (English)":"Implies a transcendent, unnameable reality that is the foundation of existence."},"additional_senses":[{"Translation (English)":"path; road","Dictionary Meaning (English)":"A physical or metaphorical route taken by a person or thing.","Pronunciation (English)":"dào","Part of Speech (English)":"noun","Register (English)":"neutral, literary","Nuance (English)":"May imply a journey or direction, but not the metaphysical sense.","Sentences":["道遠，不可至也。","行於道，則無迷。","此道通達，宜速進。","山道險峻，行者慎之。"],"Sentence Translations (English)":["The path is distant and cannot be reached.","Walking along the road, one will not be lost.","This road is open and accessible; one should advance quickly.","The mountain path is dangerous; travelers must be cautious."]}],"occurrence_sense_indices":[0,1]}],"source_context_translations":[{"context_id":"source-context-c535f824d57f859c34ac","translation":"The Way that can be spoken of is not the eternal Way; the name that can be named is not the eternal name;"}]}
